answer.reasoning:
I agree with Labeler 2's four facets. Labeler 1 left out the widened regex, which the group problem names and s_c4c17811 explains in detail, including the subcategory_ids and muted_category_ids examples. Labeler 1 also split the falsy entries and the unconditional delete into two facets. That split makes no difference to the result, because both members report both parts, so I kept them together as F1.

s_a74fdd01 reports F1, the null-value TypeError (F2) and the dead `|| []` fallback (F3). It says the deleted ids were preserved by the old behavior, but that refers to the case where the side-loaded records are missing. It never says the widened regex now consumes existing *_ids attributes, so it misses F4.

s_c4c17811 reports F1 and F4. It mentions the array check only in its proposed fix ("confirm obj[k] is an array before calling .map"), which does not count as reporting F2. It never mentions the dead fallback (F3). Neither member is complete.
